title: AdoptionResult
description: Issue #239/#285: terminal outcome of AdoptionWorkflow (operator-triggered orphan-position adoption). Returned to api-gateway POST /positions/adopt. On a successful adoption it carries the reconstructed PositionWorkflow id + broker-truth provenance (entry_signal_id, qty) so the operator and the audit trail can confirm what was started.

outcome.description: ADOPTED: a PositionWorkflow owner was reconstructed + started for the orphan. ALREADY_OWNED: a live PositionWorkflow already owns the OCC (idempotency no-op). REFUSED_NOT_HELD: the broker does not actually hold the lot (phantom guard). REFUSED_NO_ANCHOR: no entry_signal_id could be anchored from the journal, so the canonical workflow id cannot be built (documented known limitation). REFUSED_UNSAFE: an operator adoption of an unrecorded lot was refused because taking ownership could misfire (see reason).

workflow_id.description: On ADOPTED, the canonical reconstructed PositionWorkflow id (t-<tenant>/s-<strategy>/pos/<padded-occ>/<entry_signal_id>). Null otherwise.

entry_signal_id.description: On ADOPTED, the entry_signal_id anchored from the journal row that disambiguates the canonical workflow id. Null otherwise.

qty.description: On ADOPTED, the broker-derived contract quantity the owner was reconstructed with. Null otherwise.

reason.description: On REFUSED_UNSAFE, why: condor_leg (one wing of a defined-risk combo), open_sell_order (a SELL for the OCC is already working at the broker), or expired (the contract is past its last trading moment). Null otherwise.
